name: The Roblox Ragdoll Show
overview:
Each episode follows Chelsea on a particular journey, sometimes with a set goal and sometimes without one. Each episode typically lasts 15-30 minutes, and takes place in a Roblox game that Chelsea knows her way around. Starting around season six, episodes set in Rec Room started to sprout up due to a Roblox ban that would be violated many, MANY times.

A common archetype in the series is the “prison episode,” usually apparent by the episode’s dilated kill count compared to the rest in a season. Two seasons of the show even center around a prison as the main location. Other locations prevalent in the show are Ragdoll City, Deadville, Memeville, and Mount Smile.
